HOW_TO_ENABLE_AI: Paste your free API key on the api_key line, save, and restart the app. The tool auto-detects the provider from the key: a Groq key (starts with gsk_, from console.groq.com) OR a Google Gemini key (starts with AIza, from https://aistudio.google.com/apikey). If Groq is blocked on your network (Cloudflare error 1010), use a Gemini key instead - it does not go through Cloudflare.
